headline: Understanding your progress—what your learning stats show and why they matter
universal_truth: What gets measured gets improved; tracking progress reveals patterns and fuels motivation
fun_facts: Visualizing progress increases motivation and persistence
The best metrics focus on process (showing up) not just outcomes (completion)
Your stats are for you, not for comparison with others
discussion_questions: What do your stats tell you about your learning habits?
Which metrics matter most to you?
How might tracking help you improve?

hook.script: Your dashboard shows various stats about your learning journey. But what do they mean? How should you use them? Let's decode your learning metrics and make them useful.

cliff.script: Some people find tracking motivating; others find it stressful. How should you relate to your stats?

options.text: Stats are information, not judgment—they reveal patterns and fuel motivation; but they're tools for you, not measures of worth; use what helps, ignore what doesn't
options.response: Perfect approach. Stats show patterns—when you learn best, what keeps you consistent. They're data, not grades. Use them as tools, not sources of pressure.
Some metrics matter more than others. Sustainable consistency beats impressive but unsustainable peaks...

fact1.title: Your Streak
fact1.script: Your streak shows consecutive days of learning. It's motivating but not everything. A broken streak isn't failure—it's reset. The longer streak is your lifetime commitment, not your current run.

fact2.title: Lessons Completed
fact2.script: This shows total lessons finished. Watch it grow over time. Even one lesson per day adds up to 365 per year—more focused learning than most people do in a decade.

fact3.title: Your Patterns
fact3.script: Notice when you learn most consistently. Morning? Evening? Weekdays? This reveals your optimal learning windows. Lean into what works rather than fighting your natural rhythms.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: The best stat is showing up. Everything else follows from that. Track what helps, release what creates pressure.

outro.script: Check your stats with curiosity, not judgment. They're just information about your journey. Use them to understand yourself, not to stress yourself.

growTrack.title: Stats Review - Find Your Patterns
growTrack.learning_objective: Use stats to understand learning patterns
growTrack.activity: Review your dashboard. When do you learn most consistently? What breaks your streak? What patterns emerge? Use this information to optimize your routine.
